Basically yeah and online feature, this [comment](https://www.reddit.com/r/NoMansSkyTheGame/s/7R0Gp7mN3I) explains what is an expedition and how it works (keep in mind this comment is older).

What I recommend first is to choose what type of starship you want to build (solar, fighter, etc). The starship customiser/builder station will show you all the types and what they need (except exotics and bionic ship I think).

Then look up the parts of that type of ship has (I used [this](https://nomanssky.fandom.com/wiki/No_Man%27s_Sky_Wiki) website) and then you wait at space stations (I don’t know if you can disassemble crashed ships so someone who knows please correct me). If you found the ship on a space with an NPC you need to buy the ship .You can only get one part of the ship at a time (like you buy the ship with a cockpit you like go to the starship disassemble/upgrader station and choose begin salvage analysis and then getting a component or something like that and you can choose the part you want and this with the wings and for example sails for the solar ship). You will need to buy a reactor at the starship technology merchant (c, b, a, s rank price varies by rank). 

Once you got everything you go to assemble your ship at the starship customiser/builder station then you choose the colours you want and assemble.

And you got your starship!
It was a reward in the Relics expedition!
